name: 衣物局部去渍便携喷雾款
description: 衣物局部去渍喷雾，喷洒演示加清单式信任的痛点转化套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshot field, bright sky blue #2EAFDF and deep navy #14284B wave-shaped colour fields for infographic screens, pale cool grey-white #F4F7FB for lifestyle fields
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral high-key studio light, soft front key with fill card, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white bench top #FFFFFF, slate-navy utility table #24344F and pale cool grey-white field #F4F7FB
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, all claims left as empty rounded slots
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside plain white circular medallions, one accent colour only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale, product always on the clean side of the wave split, medallion grid spacing identical across screens
noDrift: no certification seals or award badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh household laundry-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, bright sky blue #2EAFDF, deep navy #14284B and one warm accent #E4572E; cool neutral high-key studio lighting with a soft front key, fill card and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icons inside plain white circular medallions; soft organic wave-shaped colour fields that split the claim column from the product column; clean high-end household product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale; every claim carried by an empty rounded slot instead of rendered words; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no certification seals.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清瓶型与喷头，抢点击并满足白底主图规范
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, bottle standing upright, full product unclipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with a soft fill card, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: even margin on all four sides, no copy zone
shots.promptTemplate: Clean packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle stands upright on a straight-on eye-level view, full product visible with the actuator cap and base inside the frame. Bright even high-key studio light from the front with a soft fill card on the shadow side, and one soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no tint and no gradient. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, leaving an even margin on all four sides and no copy zone. Square crop, commercial household e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no brand wordmark, no fake logo, no in-image text, no award or certification seals, no cartoon mascots, no gradient background, no cut-off cap or base, no floating bottle without contact shadow.

shots.intent: 主图一秒法则：用四枚空章把四条卖点位置一次交代清楚
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, bottle leaning in at the left frame edge
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadow on the blue field
shots.background: bright sky blue #2EAFDF field with a deep navy #14284B header band
shots.props: four plain white circular medallions in a two-by-two grid, each holding an empty thin-line icon slot
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the navy header band for a later headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The bottle enters from the left frame edge at a slight 3/4 hero angle and is cropped only by its own silhouette. Background is a bright sky blue #2EAFDF field under a deep navy #14284B header band, split by one soft wave-shaped edge. Soft front-left key with gentle fill and a soft contact shadow. On the right, four plain white circular medallions sit in a two-by-two grid with identical spacing, each holding one empty thin-line icon slot in the accent colour {accent_color}, sized to receive {callout_1} to {callout_4} later as blank proof placeholders. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space across the navy band. No words rendered anywhere. Negative: no more than four medallions, no filled-in labels, no invented efficacy icons, no mascot characters, no certification badge, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把衣物被食物泼脏的瞬间摊开，让买家认领自己的高频麻烦
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the chair tray and lap
shots.lighting: soft cool daylight from the upper left, 5600K, gentle realistic shadows, no glamour retouch
shots.props: a plain plate with food remnants, a sippy cup, three curved thin-line arrows pointing at stained fabric zones with blank label pills
shots.whitespace: clean negative space along the top 25% for a later headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen of a child's mealtime: {product} standing at the lower right corner while the stained sleeves and lap fabric fill the centre. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at the chair tray and lap, so only small hands, torso and clothing are visible and no face appears in frame. Soft cool daylight from the upper left at 5600K with gentle realistic shadows. Background is a pale cool grey-white #F4F7FB room field. Three curved thin-line arrows in {accent_color} point at three separate stain zones, each ending in one empty rounded label pill sized for {callout_5}, {callout_6} and {callout_7}. The scene and stained fabric occupy 40-50% of the frame, leaving clean negative space across the top 25%. No words rendered. Negative: no visible face, no identifiable child, no full body of a minor, no cartoon mascots, no invented statistics, no exaggerated or fabricated stain, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 真实手持喷洒演示，让人看清用法与作用对象
shots.camera: close 3/4 from a slightly low angle beside the working hand
shots.lighting: bright soft key from the upper right, fine even mist catching the light, soft shadow on the fabric
shots.background: white terry cloth laid over a slate-navy utility table #24344F
shots.props: one hand pressing the actuator, a second hand steadying the fabric, a fresh food-stain mark on the cloth
shots.whitespace: none, the fabric fills the lower frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle usage scene: {product} held in one hand and sprayed toward a stain mark on white terry cloth. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera is a close 3/4 from a slightly low angle beside the working hand, with the nozzle tip in the upper left and the fabric spreading across the lower frame. Bright soft key from the upper right at 5600K, a fine even mist catching that light, and a soft shadow where the cloth meets a slate-navy utility table #24344F. Realistic fabric weave with visible pile and creases, no beauty retouch. Hands are clean and ordinary, cropped at the wrist, no face in frame. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame and the rest of the frame stays as working surface with no copy zone. Negative: no sparkle particles, no glow dots, no magic-dust effect, no visible stain disappearing, no before-after trick in one frame, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no deformed fingers, no face.

shots.intent: 微距证明喷头做工与出雾结构，替掉空口口号
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, clean 90-degree side profile of the actuator and neck
shots.lighting: skimming soft light from the upper left, controlled highlight, shallow depth of field
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the spray actuator, its tip aperture and the shoulder ring beneath it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera is a clean 90-degree side profile at macro distance with a very shallow depth of field and the front edge kept sharp. Skimming soft light from the upper left reveals mould seams, thread lines and surface finish, with one controlled highlight and no blown speculars. Background is a seamless pale blue-white #EAF2F8. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a thin band of breathing room, no copy zone. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated nozzle, no redesign of the sprayer, no water droplets implying test data, no mist cloud covering the part, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no plastic-looking surface.

shots.intent: 用左右双栏勾叉位把配方取舍讲成对照，替代口头承诺
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level two matched panels with identical framing
shots.lighting: identical soft front light and identical shadow strength on both panels
shots.background: bright sky blue #2EAFDF left panel and pale cool grey-white #F4F7FB right panel
shots.props: four empty circular cross slots on the left column, four empty circular tick slots on the right column, one soft wave divider
shots.whitespace: clear gutter between the two columns, no copy zone
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison screen, two matched panels split by one soft wave-shaped divider and framed identically. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera is straight-on eye-level on both panels with the same crop height. Left panel on bright sky blue #2EAFDF holds a vertical column of four empty white circular cross slots; right panel on pale cool grey-white #F4F7FB holds a matching column of four empty white circular tick slots, plus {product} standing at its lower edge and a domestic corner behind it where a caregiver holds a child seen only from behind and cropped below the shoulders. Lighting is identical soft front light with identical shadow strength on both sides so only the slot state differs. All eight slots stay blank as empty proof placeholders for {callout_8} and {callout_9} to be composited later. Both panels together carry a product footprint of 50-60% and the columns keep a clear gutter with no copy zone. Negative: no ingredient names, no chemical abbreviations, no percentages, no real competitor product, no brand marks, no certification seals, no claims filled into the slots, no faces, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把用法压成三步流程条，消除买了不会用的顾虑
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level layout screen with three inset photos shot from above at a 45-degree angle
shots.lighting: even soft high-key light on every inset, matching direction and strength
shots.background: clean white #FFFFFF with one bright sky blue #2EAFDF wave band at the top
shots.props: three rounded photo pills stacked vertically, each paired with a solid deep navy #14284B circular icon disc showing blotting, spraying and washing hands
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 45% beside each inset for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce step-flow infographic screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The overall layout is viewed straight-on at eye level, while the three inset photographs inside it are shot from above at a 45-degree angle over a laundry bench. Background is a clean white #FFFFFF field with one bright sky blue #2EAFDF wave band across the top. Three rounded photo pills stack vertically on the left: hands blotting a stain, hands spraying with the bottle, hands placing fabric into a washer drum. Each pill is paired with a solid deep navy #14284B circular icon disc drawn in thin white line work showing the same gesture, and each pill keeps an empty title slot on its right. Even soft high-key light with matching direction and strength across all three insets. The three insets plus the product occupy 40-50% overall, leaving generous negative space on the right 45% of each row for later copy. Negative: no rendered words or step numbers, no more than three steps, no dense body text, no duplicate thumbnails, no hands covering the product, no before-after result, no watermark, no fake logo, no deformed fingers.

shots.intent: 用包袋与车内收纳位当比例锚，回答带得走吗放哪儿
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down on a row of three upright bottles
shots.lighting: even flat high-key light, soft contact shadows under each base
shots.background: deep navy #14284B field with a bright sky blue #2EAFDF wave at the left edge and a white #FFFFFF wave along the bottom
shots.props: three upright bottles in a receding row, one open backpack, one soft tote bag, one car glove compartment, three empty circular tick slots, one empty measurement bracket
shots.whitespace: clean negative space on the right 40% around the slot column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size and spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera is a high 45-degree angle looking down on a receding row of three upright bottles, arranged beside an open backpack, a soft tote bag and a car glove compartment that act as scale anchors. Background is a deep navy #14284B field with one bright sky blue #2EAFDF wave along the left edge and one white #FFFFFF wave along the bottom. Even flat high-key lighting with soft contact shadows under each bottle base. A vertical column of three empty white circular tick slots sits on the right, and one empty thin measurement bracket floats beside the tallest bottle as a blank dimension placeholder for {callout_1}; no numbers, no units and no place names are rendered. The bottles and props occupy 45-50% overall, leaving clean negative space across the right 40% around the slot column. Negative: no dimension figures, no travel approval marks, no certification seals, no bag brand logos, no clutter, no duplicate bottles with different proportions, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 收口用洗衣房实景加空清单位降风险，稳住下单前的最后一疑
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level claim column beside a lifestyle panel shot from behind at a 45-degree rear angle
shots.lighting: soft cool key from the room window side, 5500K, natural low-contrast shadows
shots.background: clean off-white #F8FAFC field with a deep navy #14284B claim column on the left
shots.props: four empty white circular tick slots stacked in the navy column, one open front-load washer with a blank dial, a folded laundry pile, a person cropped below the shoulders and a child seen from behind
shots.whitespace: generous negative space above the tick column for a later headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The left third is a deep navy #14284B claim column with four empty white circular tick slots stacked at equal spacing, kept as blank proof placeholders for {callout_2} to {callout_4} plus one more line composited later. The right two thirds is a real laundry corner photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle: an open front-load washer with its dial and display rendered as blank surfaces with no readings, a folded laundry pile on the floor, a person cropped below the shoulders and a small child seen only from behind so no face appears. Background field is a clean off-white #F8FAFC wall. Soft cool key light from the window side at 5500K with natural low-contrast shadows. The product and lifestyle panel together occupy 50-60%, with generous negative space above the tick column. Negative: no certification seals, no official badges, no award marks, no lab data, no readable dial numbers or screen readings, no faces, no ingredient lists, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 9 张源图逐张事实：001 白底单品喷雾瓶直立主图；002 手持按压喷洒、白色织物带食物渍的近景演示，下方色带放两枚奖项圆章与一句口号；003 左侧色块放白色喷头配件圆形放大窗、右侧白底瓶身，配一段配件色差说明；004 深底标题带加亮蓝场、四枚白色圆章细线图标卖点栅格；005 白场幼儿餐椅进食泼脏实景，三条弯箭头标注污渍类型，底部深色条放一句口号；006 左侧深色清单栏放四枚勾章与一枚官方认证标识，右侧洗衣房母子装衣实景；007 亮蓝场放四枚叉章与成分排除行，右侧母子贴身抱持有清晰面容；008 白场三行流程条，药丸形实景小图加深色圆图标加编号步骤与正文；009 深底三瓶排排站加三枚勾章场景位、一处尺寸数字与出行放行角标，右下角另有两种同系列其他形态包装。品类判定依据：产品是无电无电机的衣物局部清洁消耗品，Amazon 侧常挂家清类，按图取 L1 家居日用、L2 纸品清洁（清洁消耗品，非家务工具类的手动器具，也非护肤个护的人体清洁），leaf 定为衣物局部去渍喷雾。已剥离：瓶身品牌字与系列名、俏皮口号原句、两枚奖项圆章与官方认证标识、出行放行角标、尺寸数字与容量标注、卡通污渍小怪插画、全部英文标题与正文文案、成人与幼儿可辨识面容；「即时起效」「配方不含某类成分」等断言一律改成空勾叉章与 {callout_n} 空位，仪表与段码写为空白无读数。
